_meta.note: Action Fraud was replaced by Report Fraud (reportfraud.police.uk, same phone number 0300 123 2040) from 4 December 2025 for England, Wales and Northern Ireland. Scotland reports to Police Scotland on 101. Steps are short imperatives for UI display; channels list the official reporting routes with sources.

uk_7726.name: Forward scam texts to 7726
uk_7726.how: Forward the text to 7726 (free), then reply with the sender's number when asked. For a suspicious call, text 'Call' plus the number to 7726.

uk_ncsc_website.name: Report a scam website to the NCSC
uk_ncsc_website.how: Use the NCSC suspicious website form

uk_report_fraud.name: Report Fraud (formerly Action Fraud)
uk_report_fraud.how: Report online or call 0300 123 2040 (England, Wales, Northern Ireland). In Scotland call Police Scotland on 101. Call 999 if a crime is happening now or you are in danger.

uk_159.name: Call 159 to reach your bank
uk_159.how: Hang up, then dial 159 from a phone you trust to be connected to your bank's real fraud line. Covers most UK current accounts including Barclays, HSBC, Lloyds, NatWest, Santander, Monzo, Revolut, Starling.

uk_hmrc.name: Report HMRC scams
uk_hmrc.how: Forward HMRC scam texts to 60599 (network charges apply) and emails to phishing@hmrc.gov.uk

uk_royal_mail.name: Report Royal Mail scams
uk_royal_mail.how: Forward emails (or screenshots of texts) to reportascam@royalmail.com

uk_whatsapp_report.name: Report in WhatsApp
uk_whatsapp_report.how: Press and hold the message, tap Report, then block the sender

uk_psr_reimbursement.name: Get your money back if you were tricked into paying
uk_psr_reimbursement.how: If you were tricked into sending a bank payment, tell your bank as soon as possible and within 13 months. Reimbursement is usually within 5 business days of the claim; firms may apply an excess of up to £100 (not for vulnerable customers).

uk_cifas.name: Cifas Protective Registration
uk_cifas.how: Paid service that flags your identity so lenders do extra checks if someone applies for credit in your name

uk_ncsc_hacked.name: Recover a hacked account
uk_ncsc_hacked.how: Follow NCSC steps to regain access, change passwords and turn on 2-step verification

us_7726.name: Forward scam texts to 7726 (SPAM)
us_7726.how: Forward the text to 7726 or use your phone's 'Report junk' option

us_ftc.name: ReportFraud.ftc.gov
us_ftc.how: Report the scam to the Federal Trade Commission

us_identitytheft.name: IdentityTheft.gov
us_identitytheft.how: Get a personal recovery plan if your personal or financial details were exposed

us_ic3.name: FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center
us_ic3.how: File a complaint, especially for online fraud with money lost (crypto, investment, tech support)

us_credit_freeze.name: Credit freeze or fraud alert
us_credit_freeze.how: Freeze your credit with each bureau, or place a fraud alert

us_irs.name: Report IRS scams
us_irs.how: Email phishing@irs.gov (subject 'IRS' for emails, 'Text' for texts with sender number, date and time) and forward texts to 7726

us_uspis.name: Report USPS smishing
us_uspis.how: Email the text body and a screenshot to spam@uspis.gov without clicking the link, and forward the text to 7726

us_get_money_back.name: Try to get money back
us_get_money_back.how: Contact the bank, payment app, gift card issuer, wire service or crypto exchange you paid through immediately and ask them to reverse the payment

eu_national_police.name: Report to your national police
eu_national_police.how: Use your country's online cybercrime reporting site (Europol lists them by country). If your country has no online option, go to your local police station. Call 112 in an emergency.

eu_europol_guide.name: Europol scam prevention guide
eu_europol_guide.how: Advice on common online financial scams (phishing, smishing, tech support, romance, ID theft, SIM swapping)

eu_ecc_net.name: European Consumer Centres Network
eu_ecc_net.how: Free help with cross-border purchase disputes inside the EU, Iceland and Norway

eu_ie_garda.name: Ireland: report to An Garda Síochána
eu_ie_garda.how: Report fraud to your local Garda station (Garda station directory on garda.ie). Call 999 or 112 in an emergency.

eu_de_onlinewache.name: Germany: Onlinewache (police online report)
eu_de_onlinewache.how: File a criminal complaint online with the police of the federal state where it happened. Call 110 in an emergency.

eu_de_phishing_radar.name: Germany: Verbraucherzentrale Phishing-Radar
eu_de_phishing_radar.how: Forward suspicious emails to phishing@verbraucherzentrale.nrw so the consumer centre can warn others

eu_de_bsi.name: Germany: BSI Service Center
eu_de_bsi.how: Free IT security advice from the Federal Office for Information Security on 0800 274 1000 or service-center@bsi.bund.de

eu_fr_17cyber.name: France: 17Cyber
eu_fr_17cyber.how: Online diagnosis and help for cybercrime victims, run by the Police nationale, Gendarmerie nationale and Cybermalveillance.gouv.fr

eu_fr_pharos.name: France: PHAROS (internet-signalement.gouv.fr)
eu_fr_pharos.how: Report illegal online content to PHAROS. Victims of online scams (fake shops, hacked email accounts, extortion) can file an online complaint (THESEE) linked from the site. In an emergency call 17.

eu_fr_33700.name: France: report spam texts and calls to 33700
eu_fr_33700.how: Report unwanted SMS or calls on 33700.fr (form or screenshot); reports are passed to phone operators daily

eu_nl_fraudehelpdesk.name: Netherlands: Fraudehelpdesk
eu_nl_fraudehelpdesk.how: Report fraud online or call 088 786 73 72; forward fake emails via the 'valse e-mail melden' page

eu_es_incibe_017.name: Spain: INCIBE helpline 017
eu_es_incibe_017.how: Call 017 (free, confidential, 8:00 to 23:00 every day), WhatsApp 900 116 117 or Telegram @INCIBE017

eu_it_polizia_postale.name: Italy: Polizia Postale online report
eu_it_polizia_postale.how: Send an online report (segnalazione) or report a cybercrime on the Commissariato di PS Online

eu_lt_cert.name: Lithuania: report scam attempts to NKSC (CERT-LT)
eu_lt_cert.how: Email scam websites, calls and messages to cert@nksc.lt

eu_lt_epolicija.name: Lithuania: report to police at epolicija.lt
eu_lt_epolicija.how: If you lost money or data, report it to the police through epolicija.lt. Call 112 in an emergency.

eu_pl_cert_8080.name: Poland: forward scam texts to 8080
eu_pl_cert_8080.how: Forward the whole suspicious SMS to 8080 (free in Poland). Report emails and websites at incydent.cert.pl or cert@cert.pl.

eu_pl_cert_incident.name: Poland: CERT Polska incident report
eu_pl_cert_incident.how: Report phishing websites and other incidents online
